ea.title: Install the EA for automatic sync
ea.protoDownload: Prototype: no download yet; the EA is built in step 5
ea.readOnly: Reads account data only. It never opens, modifies or closes orders
ea.step2: Put it in the Experts folder
ea.step2b: In the terminal: File → Open Data Folder → MQL5 (MQL4 on MT4) → Experts, then refresh the Navigator.
ea.step3b: Tools → Options → Expert Advisors: tick “Allow WebRequest for listed URL” and add:
ea.step4: Drag the EA onto any chart and paste your token
ea.step4b: One token per trading account. The EA pushes equity and newly closed trades every 60 seconds.
ea.tokenHidden: Token hidden. Regenerate it if you lost it
ea.tokenOnce: This token is shown only once, so copy it now. Regenerating revokes the old one immediately.
ea.vpsHint: The EA only pushes while the terminal is running. Use a VPS, or upload or forward statements instead.
ea.troubleshoot: Check that the terminal is running, the EA shows a smiley on the chart, the WebRequest URL is listed and the token hasn't been regenerated
prop.formula.ftmo-2step: Daily limit: balance at 00:00 CE(S)T − 5% of initial capital. Max loss: 90% of initial capital. Both measured on equity.
prop.formula.ftmo-1step: Daily limit: balance at 00:00 CE(S)T − 3% of initial capital. Max loss: highest 00:00 balance so far − 10% of initial capital (it only moves up). Both measured on equity.

landing.headline: Know how far you are from your prop firm's red line — every day
landing.sub: An MT4 / MT5 trading journal: real P&L after commission and swap, the sessions where you lose, and red lines estimated from your prop firm's rules.
landing.point1: Red lines from each firm's published rules
landing.point1b: FTMO and other firms calculate limits differently. We model each one from its official rules and show the source.
landing.point2: Real P&L after commission and swap
landing.point2b: See how much costs eat into your profit, and which symbols and sessions lose money.
landing.point3b: One message every morning: what you made yesterday and how much room you have today.

landing.how2: The dashboard works out net P&L, win rate, drawdown and red lines
